posts.text:
A judge in Alaska denied Democrat Mary Peltola’s campaign access to information about voters whose absentee ballots were rejected. 

The campaign had sued state election officials for the voters’ names and reasons their ballots were rejected.
posts.text_ko:

캠페인은 유권자의 이름과 투표 용지가 거부된 이유를 이유로 주 선거 공무원을 고소했습니다.
